rules.title: Ticket line and ticket totals
rules.statement: A ticket line total is units times unit price. The ticket total is the sum of its line totals plus the tax computed per tax rate. Each line references one tax (TICKETLINES.TAXID -> TAXES.RATE).
rules.formula:
line_base  = TICKETLINES.UNITS * TICKETLINES.PRICE
line_tax   = line_base * TAXES.RATE                 # per line's tax
ticket_base = sum(line_base)
ticket_tax  = sum(line_tax)                          # stored per rate in TAXLINES (BASE, AMOUNT)
ticket_total = ticket_base + ticket_tax

evidence.locator: TICKETLINES(UNITS DOUBLE, PRICE DOUBLE, TAXID->TAXES); TAXES(RATE DOUBLE, RATECASCADE, RATEORDER); TAXLINES(BASE, AMOUNT)
evidence.note: shipped schema shows the computation chain

rules.notes: The schema proves the data path. Exact rounding (per line vs per ticket) and the RATECASCADE / RATEORDER compound-tax order are NOT yet observed: a run is needed. Amounts are DOUBLE in storage; a rebuild should still compute in integer minor units or a decimal type and confirm the rounding against an observed ticket.

rules.title: Payment and change
rules.statement: A ticket is settled by one or more payments (cash, card, ...). The total paid must cover the ticket total; for cash, the change is the tendered amount minus the ticket total.
rules.formula:
paid = sum(PAYMENTS.TOTAL for the receipt)
change = tendered_cash - ticket_total        # cash only
settled when paid >= ticket_total

evidence.locator: PAYMENTS(RECEIPT->RECEIPTS, PAYMENT type, TOTAL DOUBLE); RECEIPTS one per ticket

features.title: Ring up a ticket and take payment
features.user_goal: As a cashier, I add products to a ticket, see the total with tax, take payment and get the change, so the sale is recorded.
preconditions: at least one product with a price and a tax category exists

steps.does: adds one or more products (each becomes a ticket line)
computes line totals and the ticket total with tax
chooses a payment method and tenders an amount
computes change, records receipt, payment and tax lines

outputs.description: ticket, ticket lines, receipt, payment(s) and tax lines stored

acceptance.given: a product at 10.00 with a 20% tax, cash session open
acceptance.when: the cashier adds 3 units and tenders 40.00 cash

evidence.locator: TICKETS, TICKETLINES, RECEIPTS, PAYMENTS, TAXLINES, TAXES.RATE
